profile.headline: Web Developer at Titan Technologies
profile.summary:
Web developer who constructs websites for a government client utilizing a ASP.NET/MVC and/or SharePoint stack powered by C# and Javascript. Skilled in creating packaged solutions. Highly intelligent, persistent, and self-disciplined. Experienced in building websites in accordance with client requirements, and exceeding expectations. Hobbyist Android/Java App developer building his own project to assist creative writers in constructing worlds for story-building within the context of a collaborative experience.

I maintain choochoo.js and the SearchKendoTreeview Nuget package which you can find on my github at https://github.com/Grimshire/.

You can find my medium blog at: https://adamrturner.medium.com/

Some jsfiddles that are in various states can be found at https://jsfiddle.net/FirePrism/.

I also wrote an android app over several years called Quicklore that I'm keeping out of the app store due to expenses with the backend (it uses Firebase).

positions.title: Web Developer/SharePoint Developer
positions.description:
• Developed a new Conference Room SharePoint application to enhance user experience.  
• Optimized Master Pages by consolidating JS/CSS, improving load times during production deployment.  
• Created an Excel Add-In in VB.Net for seamless SharePoint REST API integration.  
• Mentored junior developers and recommended appropriate technologies for various projects.
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET · JavaScript Libraries · JavaScript · GItlabs · SharePoint

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Worked on an application involving Blazor, C#, and Bootstrap with a git version control system in an Agile environment.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript Libraries · .NET Framework · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · SQL · ASP.NET Core · Blazor · ASP.NET Web API · Front-End Development · jQuery · Git

positions.title: SharePoint/PowerApps Developer
positions.description:
Wrote front-end code for SharePoint environment that leveraged 3rd party Crow Canyon for forms, charts, and graphs. Provided real-time support for customers. Extended functionality of Crow Canyon reports by intercepting underlying Kendo objects and extending the functionality with advanced configurations and conjoining that with SharePoint REST API calls. Constructed PowerApps and worked with SharePoint 2016 and SharePoint Online environments.

Developed 2 PowerApps based on old Crow Canyon apps to support migration to Office 365 environnement.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript Libraries · JavaScript · Kendo Ui · Microsoft Power Apps · Microsoft Power Automate · SharePoint · Front-End Development · jQuery · Git

positions.title: SharePoint/Powerapps Developer/Admin
positions.description: Wrote PowerApps for enterprise client utilizing PowerAutomate. Additionally, wrote an Excel based application in VB.Net for Smart Card scanning and recording users.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript Libraries · Front-End Development · jQuery · Git

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Vue.js, jQuery, C#, TSQL, JSOM stack. Built solution for backing up SharePoint data utilizing only JSOM and a web part.
Fixed and improved existing design with Kendo UI features such as tabs and grid controls
Swapped out old graphics with Font Awesome
Wrote Frontend and Database code, occasionally manipulated OOB SharePoint control. Introduced vue.js to the team and project, enabling databinding and better custom controls. Made beautiful GUI.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · .NET Framework · JavaScript Frameworks · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · SQL · ASP.NET Web API · Front-End Development · jQuery · Full-Stack Development · Git
